title: Coordination ledger event (one JSONL line in PRIME_SILO_HOME/coordination/tasks.jsonl)

agent.description: Registered agent id — membership checked against coordination/agents.json by the validator (registry is extensible; not a schema enum by design)

task_id.description: Task this event belongs to; '-' for knowledge_added events not tied to a task

run_id.description: Optional — links a ledger task to a G0 run-event stream (runs/<run_id>/events.jsonl)

prev.description: Tamper-evidence chain: first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 of the previous raw ledger line, or 'genesis'. Set by the appender, never by the caller.
